headline: 18 dead, 37 injured in stampede at Kolkata Puja pandal
summary: A sudden rain shower triggered a crush of people at the Chorbagan Sarbojanin Puja pandal, leading to multiple casualties during Durga Puja celebrations.
details: At least 18 people, including women and children, were killed and 37 others injured in a stampede at a Durga Puja pandal in North Kolkata's Chorbagan area.
caption:
A festive celebration turned into tragedy in Kolkata as a sudden rain shower triggered a stampede, leaving at least 18 people dead.

At least 18 people, including women and children, were killed and 37 others injured in a stampede at a Durga Puja pandal in North Kolkata's Chorbagan area.

headline_marked: Satkhira: [[Prime accused Amini arrested]] in mob killing case
headline: Satkhira: Prime accused Amini arrested in mob killing case
summary: Fazlul Haque Amini, a local leader of the 'Tawhidi Janata', was apprehended by police and the SRB in a joint drive.
details: Fazlul Haque Amini, the prime accused in the murder case of Wahiduzzaman Shamim, has been arrested. He was apprehended during a joint drive by police and the SRB in the Krishnanagar area of Kaliganj upazila.

Wahiduzzaman Shamim was beaten to death by a mob on October 13. He was attacked in two separate incidents, the second of which occurred inside the Debhata Upazila Health Complex while under police protection.
The violence was triggered by an audio recording of a conversation between Shamim and his wife that circulated locally, leading to allegations that he had hurt religious sentiments.
According to Shamim's brother, Amini had gone live on Facebook to allege blasphemy and call people to gather against the victim.
A case was filed by the victim's elder brother, naming 10 people including Amini as accused, along with 200 to 250 unidentified suspects.
Two other accused persons, Mukter Hossain Khan and Asadul Islam Molla, have already been arrested and sent to jail by the court.
caption:
A man was beaten to death by a mob, including inside a health complex. The prime accused has now been arrested.

Fazlul Haque Amini, the prime accused in the murder case of Wahiduzzaman Shamim, has been arrested. He was apprehended during a joint drive by police and the SRB in the Krishnanagar area of Kaliganj upazila.

Wahiduzzaman Shamim was beaten to death by a mob on October 13. He was attacked in two separate incidents, the second of which occurred inside the Debhata Upazila Health Complex while under police protection.

The violence was triggered by an audio recording of a conversation between Shamim and his wife that circulated locally, leading to allegations that he had hurt religious sentiments.

According to Shamim's brother, Amini had gone live on Facebook to allege blasphemy and call people to gather against the victim.

A case was filed by the victim's elder brother, naming 10 people including Amini as accused, along with 200 to 250 unidentified suspects.

Two other accused persons, Mukter Hossain Khan and Asadul Islam Molla, have already been arrested and sent to jail by the court.

Source: The Daily Star, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo
